summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is titled "Shop" and features four main options for in-app purchases. The options are presented as red buttons with white text. The available options are:

1. "REMOVE ADS - $1.99": This option allows the user to remove advertisements from the app for a fee of $1.99.
2. "DONATE - $4.49": This option allows the user to make a donation of $4.49.
3. "DONATE - $16.99": This option allows the user to make a donation of $16.99.
4. "DONATE - $19.99": This option allows the user to make a donation of $19.99.

The screen is simple and straightforward, providing users with clear choices for supporting the app financially.
